title: How I elevated an entire product ecosystem while keeping existing user habits intact
intro: As Senior UX/UI Designer at Studydrive, I took a critical look at all key digital touchpoints to spot what could be improved. I modernised and visually refined the entire experience while fixing pain points and bringing more clarity, structure, and consistency.
